status_summary: On 2025-02-24 SBA's Administrator announced elimination of the Office of Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility, a pause of the Green Lender Initiative, and a return of the Small Disadvantaged Business contracting goal to its statutory 5 percent from 15 percent; SBA's 2025-04-29 release repeated these steps. On 2026-08-11 SBA published a final rule (91 FR 51568), effective 2026-09-10, removing the rebuttable presumption of social disadvantage for individually owned 8(a) applicants and requiring an individual showing, citing a 2023 court injunction, and on 2026-09-29 it removed affirmative action provisions from its Title VI regulations in 13 CFR part 112 (91 FR 61295), effective on publication. No action ending duplicative training pilot programs in favor of existing counseling partners or setting a first-come, first-served rule was found, so only part of the recommendation is matched.
